Preferred way to view memory usage, Portainer also uses this method compared to showing RSS memory usage.

NOTE: This graph joins all containers with the same name together sometimes causing visible memory usage spikes when recreating containers. Toggle the `Split Containers` query in the panel editing UI to change this behavior.
